gaussian_random_walk.implementation_policy: for exact reproduction, run or numerically qualify against the pinned PyMC3/Theano environment before substituting a modern closed-form/alternative implementation

light_smoothing.kernel: Gaussian evaluated from -3.5 to +3.5 sigma and normalized

offset_correction.operation: subtract one global offset per experiment

sign_convention.authority_note: sign is frozen from published author clarification plus ipsilateral DNa02 steering results; it may not be flipped after numeric extraction
sign_convention.expected_relational_sign: positive predictor corresponds to positive/rightward rotational velocity

historical_integral_correction.predeclared_sensitivity: report a /1.5 firing-rate-scale sensitivity separately; it may not replace the primary method based on Figure 3 outcome
historical_integral_correction.primary_policy: do not apply in v2 primary reconstruction because it is absent from the version-of-record method description and occurs in a superseded derivative-threshold spike path

smoothts_conformance.recurrence: y[0] = x[0]; y[t] = alpha*x[t] + (1-alpha)*y[t-1] for t>0

version_of_record.alignment_direction: neural data shifted forward so activity at t is paired with behavior at t+150 ms
version_of_record.kinematic_preprocessing: offset correction, 50 ms Gaussian smoothing, then Gaussian-random-walk MAP smoothing before Figure 3 colormap/binning analyses
version_of_record.spike_bin_policy: non-overlapping; integer 10 kHz sample indices map to 100-sample bins
version_of_record.spike_detection: relative-prominence peak detection using MATLAB findpeaks

prominence_conformance.qualification_scope: strict interior local maxima with non-flat peaks
prominence_conformance.edge_policy: endpoint maxima are not accepted as spikes
prominence_conformance.plateau_policy: portable conformance does not assert MATLAB equivalence for flat-topped peaks; extractor must surface any plateau case rather than silently resolving it
prominence_conformance.threshold_policy: the eight frozen project thresholds remain unchanged regardless of conformance outcome
